recent: Our Mixed Grill Platter is a proper feast 🔥 Lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings, all flame-grilled over charcoal and served with naan and salad, just £18.50. Perfect for sharing (or not, we won't judge). Pop in tonight and dig in!
This weekend: a free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter. See you Saturday!

checks.reason: Short, upbeat and friendly, not pushy. Profile voice is met.
Names the Mixed Grill Platter and its contents, which is specific to this restaurant.
Closing "Pop in tonight!" repeats the previous post's closing "Pop in tonight and dig in!". Topic also repeats the Mixed Grill Platter post from the last outputs.
checks.fix: Use a different closing line. Also check the Mixed Grill topic was not posted within 3 weeks.

checks.reason: No em-dashes, no emojis, words_to_avoid is empty.
"hand-slaughtered" and "HMC certified" are not in any source. Profile only says "All our meat is halal."
checks.fix: Remove "hand-slaughtered" and "HMC certified". Use "All our meat is halal."

checks.reason: £18.50 matches the Mixed Grill Platter price of 18.5.

Today is Friday 9 October 2026 and Friday hours are 14:00 to 00:00, so "tonight" is fine for opening. But the post is not date-anchored and a Google post could be seen outside Friday. "Pop in tonight" is time-sensitive wording that may be stale when read.
checks.fix: Replace "tonight" with timeless wording such as "Pop in and see us", or give the opening hours from the profile.

checks.reason: "Mixed Grill Platter" matches the menu. Item names lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings are close to menu items (Peri Peri Wings is the menu name, "wings" is acceptable shorthand). The contents list is not in the profile description, which is null, so see F1 note.
"hand-slaughtered" and "HMC certified halal" go beyond the profile halal statement "All our meat is halal." Slaughter method and certification body are unverified.
checks.fix: Remove both claims, or get the owner to confirm and add them to the profile.

checks.reason: No offer made. Price is plain.
No financial, legal or staffing advice.
No phone number or link in the post text.

Breaks the maker rule that halal claims come only from the profile. May also break the rule not to repeat a Google post topic within 3 weeks, since the previous output is also a Mixed Grill Platter post.
checks.fix: Use only the profile halal statement. Choose a different topic or confirm the last Mixed Grill post is older than 3 weeks.

recorded.owner_question: Is your meat hand-slaughtered and certified by HMC? Neither is in your profile yet, so we can only say "All our meat is halal." until you confirm.
recorded.notes: The halal claims need the owner's confirmation, so this escalates. If the owner says no, the maker should use only "All our meat is halal." and also fix the repeated closing, the "tonight" wording and the topic repeat. The contents list (lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab, wings) is not in the menu descriptions, so it should be confirmed alongside the halal claim.
